solution.title: Entra Global Secure Access (Internet & Private Access)

products.name: Entra Global Secure Access (Internet & Private Access) — Commercial
products.short_description: Deliver Microsoft's SSE — secure access to internet, SaaS, and private apps through Entra Global Secure Access, identity-conditioned and logged.
products.description:
Deliver Microsoft's SSE — secure access to internet, SaaS, and private apps through Entra Global Secure Access, identity-conditioned and logged.

VPNs backhaul traffic and expose flat network access; unmanaged SaaS and internet use go uninspected. Global Secure Access (Entra's Security Service Edge) replaces that: deploy the client and connectors, secure Microsoft/Internet/Private Access traffic profiles, tie access to Conditional Access and Continuous Access Evaluation, and get per-app private access without a VPN.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • GSA client rollout + Private Access connectors (as code where possible)
  • Traffic profiles — Microsoft, Internet Access (SWG), Private Access (ZTNA)
  • Per-app private access (replace VPN) with segmented, identity-based access
  • Conditional Access + Continuous Access Evaluation integration
  • Logging/monitoring and a pilot-first, staged rollout

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

A working SSE on Entra — VPN-less private app access, inspected internet/SaaS traffic, all identity-conditioned and logged.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTGSA-ConnectorHealth.ps1 — report Private Access connector groups and connector health (read-only)
    • ENTGSA-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Entra Global Secure Access configuration (read-only, Microsoft Graph)
    • ENTGSA-Report.ps1 — export Global Secure Access traffic evidence via KQL against Log Analytics (read-only)
    • ENTGSA-TrafficLogs.ps1 — focused KQL for GSA blocked/denied flows and Private Access outcomes (read-only)
    • ENTGSA-Validate.ps1 — validate the named GSA objects from 03-implementation are present and wired

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
